notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.notes: [h1]Demo Update 3 Patch Notes:[/h1][p]This is probably the last demo update asides from patches etc.[/p][h2]New Stuff:[/h2][p]- Lighting  [/p][p]- Saving and loading![/p][p]- All soundtracks are now made entirely by myself![/p][p]- Most graphic assets have been remade [/p][p]- In world time changes based on your progress in the story [/p][p]- Indication of when the chapter changes [/p][p]- New puzzle after acquiring the Pickaxe - Dialogue system rework     [/p][p]- Portraits, text backdrop, alternate forms [/p][p]- Caves now have new decoration (stalagmites, etc) [/p][p]- Can now switch between a toggle and a hold for wheel usage [/p][p][/p][h2]Changes:[/h2][p]- Altered dialogue in certain points in the game [/p][p]- Changed the tutorial for using the Ring and Glove [/p][p]- A variety of small changes to different areas [/p][p]- Movement altered a little (feels more slippery per se, especially in snowy areas)  [/p][p]- Zoom in during dialogue[/p][p]- Hopefully cleared up some areas that people get stuck in.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p]- Optimisation [/p][p]- Patched a potential soft lock with resetting and changing areas at the same time (hopefully) [/p][p]- Fixed getting stuck next to walls in icy areas.  [/p][p][/p][h2]Roadmap:[/h2][p]- None[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938144/7bbf13191622d36ee1908589cdbc39aeadde7c2d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hopefully I haven't screwed something over with this update.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo Update 2 Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]New Stuff:[/h2]
- Revamp of platform inventory/wheel system.
- Experimental bloom feature accessible in the options menu
- New soundtracks for different locations (Caves, Mountains,[spoiler] Underworld [/spoiler],[spoiler] Tunnel [/spoiler]
- New sound effects
- A little more content before the Rift happens


[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- Minor alterations to glove tutorial and ring tutorial inscriptions
- Room layout changes to hopefully make it clearer where to go
- A difficult puzzle was simplified
- Max capacity of platforms removed, not that it mattered anyways.
- General dialogue changes especially to the lengthy sections to make them a little more interesting
   - "You" also talk a bit more with the voice


[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed logbook sometimes having multiple empty lines before a filled one.
- General optimization to game performance


[h2]Roadmap:[/h2]
- Revamp of tutorials
- More sound effects
- Day to night transition depending on game progress

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1 Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]New Stuff:[/h2]
- Climbing system has been reworked to allow more oomph when jumping off walls
- Discord and Steam wishlist buttons added to main menu


[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- New sky background
- New [spoiler] Underworld [/spoiler] background
- Minor alterations to parallax of backgrounds
- Snow texture changed
- Movement values tweaked slightly


[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- Dialogue at end of demo changed from saying "go left for this and left for that" to "go left for this and RIGHT for that" 
- Heavy optimisation with area transitions.




There was a few other things I did but I forgot to write them down.

[h2]Roadmap:[/h2]
- New backgrounds
- Bloom effect
- Other graphical stuff
- New soundtracks 
- New cover art.

notes.title: Demo Release Date
notes.notes:
After nearly nine months of development it's time to release the demo of Rift Walker.
Releasing May 27th, 17:00 (5pm) AEST, Have fun!

Post-release edit:
Why are you here? It's out, go play and enjoy!
